segments.he: סִימַן: הַתָּרַת יְבָמָה סַנְדָּל. אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה אָמַר רַב: הַתָּרַת יְבָמָה לַשּׁוּק — בִּשְׁמִיטַת רוֹב הֶעָקֵב.
segments.en: § The Gemara presents «a mnemonic» device for the following three halakhot that Rav Yehuda taught in the name of Rav: «Hatarat,» meaning release of; «yevama; sandal.» This mnemonic serves as a reminder that the release of a yevama is done through removing a sandal. «Rav Yehuda said» that «Rav said: The release of a yevama» to enable her marriage «to» a member of «the public occurs when most of the heel is removed» from the shoe. Even though the shoe has not been entirely removed, or even removed from most of the yavam’s foot; it is still permitted for her to remarry.

moves.summary: Release occurs when most of the heel is removed.
moves.about: the yevama is released when most of the heel is out of the sandal

edges.about: the yevama is released when most of the heel is out of the sandal

positions.claim: the yevama is released to marry when most of the heel is removed

unresolved.issue: the mnemonic covers three rulings; only the first falls in this unit
